rate_path.rationale: The minutes show a clear consensus on maintaining a restrictive policy stance, with all participants agreeing on a path of ongoing rate increases to return inflation to 2 percent. No one anticipated rate cuts in 2023, and forward guidance emphasizes continued tightening.
